why: grant.json / run-record bindings.allocationItem are written by the driver from a constant that names allocation #1. This file maps the ACTUAL allocation of the run to its grant, so the evidence is unambiguous without editing a file the driver wrote. Updating the constant is deferred to a future run so the committed driver stays byte-identical to the one that executed.
